channel.title: ShipRank Weekly – AI builder tool launches
channel.description: Verified AI tool launches for vibe coders and builders.

item.title: Replit Monitoring Agent
item.description: An autonomous on-call agent for apps published on Replit: it reads production logs and metrics, investigates alerts, validates a fix and can auto-publish it, then emails you a summary. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: Wodby Agent for vibe coding
item.description: Describe an app and Wodby Agent picks a stack, creates a private repo in your own GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, builds it in a live workspace with previews, opens a PR and deploys to infrastructure you control or Wodby Cloud. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: Recursive Flint
item.description: Free, Apache 2.0 coding model small enough to run on a laptop (40B-parameter MoE, 2.5B active), so you can code offline and keep your code private. Download on Hugging Face. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: Claude Duet (research preview)
item.description: Anthropic's proactive agent app: runs tasks on its own cloud computer, sends a morning brief from your connected apps, can prototype and build web apps, and asks before sending, paying or deleting. Waitlist for US Pro and Max. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: OpenAI models and Codex on Google Cloud (private preview)
item.description: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex workflows are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden, billed via Google Cloud Marketplace; private preview now, GA planned in the coming weeks. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: GemDB Code (VS Code extension)
item.description: Free VS Code extension with an object database where your code is the schema, so you or your coding agent change a class and commit with no migration scripts. Python only at launch; includes an MCP server. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: Vercel WebSockets in Functions (GA)
item.description: WebSocket support in Vercel Functions is generally available, for AI chat, streaming and realtime multiplayer apps, at normal Function pricing (CPU billed only while processing messages). (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: Lovable can create your Supabase project
item.description: Ask Lovable to create a Supabase project for an app with no backend: pick the organisation and region and Lovable creates and connects it, billed to your own Supabase org. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: Mistral Voxtral 3 + voice agent SDK
item.description: New speech-to-text and text-to-speech models (50+ languages) plus a voice agent SDK that listens, reasons, calls tools and speaks in one real-time pipeline. Transcription from $0.0035/min. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: v0: Slack MCP integration
item.description: Connect Slack to v0 so it can use team discussions as context for a change and post updates to Slack when you ask. Available on all v0 plans. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w43/)

item.title: Perplexity Computer: REA reverse-engineering skill
item.description: New /reverse-engineer skill lets Computer inspect an existing app without its source and rebuild a working version, using the open-source REA MCP toolkit. Tasks free up to 10,000 credits per user until 31 Oct. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Cursor: canvases from cloud agents + Environments API (beta)
item.description: Cloud agents can build shareable interactive canvases; Environments API in beta; environments now support up to 300 repos and load 5x faster. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Chainguard Workspaces and Checks (beta)
item.description: Hardened microVM dev environments for developers and coding agents, plus fast in-loop CI checks agents can call via MCP or SDK. 30-day beta trials. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Band for Developers
item.description: Desktop app and CLI for managing a team of coding agents at once: projects, ownership, blockers, questions and progress in one view. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Meta Muse Spark Open
item.description: Coding-optimised open-weight MoE model (816B, 42B active) with 1M-token context. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Vercel Token Pass (early access)
item.description: $30/month for $80 of GLM 5.3 and Kimi K3 credit via AI Gateway, for Pro teams. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Vercel AI SDK 7
item.description: AI SDK becomes a provider-agnostic toolkit for building multi-turn agents, announced at Vercel Ship 2026. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: GitHub AI Scan for PRs (GA)
item.description: AI vulnerability scanning on pull requests, complementing CodeQL. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: GitHub agentic autofix for code scanning (GA)
item.description: Agents propose fixes for code scanning alerts. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Claude Code Review (GA)
item.description: Multi-agent review of GitHub pull requests is out of research preview for Claude Team and Enterprise, with reviews ~3x faster (6-10 min) and Quick, Standard or Deep levels per repo. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Lovable: AI models and tools inside your apps
item.description: Apps built in Lovable can now use GPT-Live voice, the latest Claude models, Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini Omni, Lyria, Perplexity, Firecrawl, Parallel and Jev without leaving Lovable. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Bluesky Attie site builder
item.description: "Social vibe coding": describe a poll, quiz, guestbook or game and Attie builds a shareable page on attie.site that Bluesky followers can sign in to and use. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Builder.io Agent-Native (beta)
item.description: Open-source TypeScript framework for agentic apps where the agent and UI share actions, data and state; every app is also an MCP server and supports A2A. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Graphicle (KarLex AI)
item.description: Open-source Rust tool giving coding agents local code graphs and memory via MCP. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Google's newest frontier model now GA in Copilot. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w42/)

item.title: Replit: cross-project chat + Windows Desktop preview
item.description: Send tasks across projects from one chat; Windows desktop app in private preview. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w41/)

item.title: Google Gemini agent
item.description: Universal work agent that writes and runs code, announced at Gemini at Work 2026. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w41/)

item.title: Supabase Select: code-first backend + app MCP servers
item.description: Schema/config in code for agents, Docker-free local Supabase (alpha), and authenticated MCP servers for your app. (ShipRank weekly roundup: https://tobychecketts.github.io/shiprank/weekly/2026-w40/)
